Class IRenderTarget

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a render target resource instance, which is a texture that can be rendered to during rendering operations. A render target allows you to draw graphics onto a texture, enabling techniques such as off-screen rendering, post-processing effects, and dynamic texture generation.

public class IRenderTarget : AuraResourcePointer, IDisposable

MsaaDescription

Gets the MSAA description of the render target, which includes the sample count and quality level used for multisample anti-aliasing. This information is important for understanding the anti-aliasing capabilities of the render target and how it will affect rendering quality and performance. Lets you get just that without having to get the entire description if you only care about the MSAA settings. Note that the MSAA settings are also included in the full description, so you can get them from there as well if you need other information at the same time.

public MsaaDesc MsaaDescription { get; }

Methods

Bind(int)

Binds the texture to a slot for rendering. This makes the render target's texture available for use in shader resource bindings, allowing it to be sampled or read from during rendering operations.

public void Bind(int slot)
